svg.title: BGA pads: copper-defined and mask-defined
svg.desc: Enlarged, drawn to scale, cross-sections through one solder ball of a 0.8 mm-pitch BGA after reflow. Left, copper-defined (NSMD): a 0.35 mm copper pad with a mask opening 0.45 mm across, so the mask does not touch the pad and the solder wraps round the pad's sides. Right, mask-defined (SMD): a 0.45 mm pad with the mask overlapping its edge to leave a 0.35 mm opening, so the solder meets the mask in a notch.

g.text: Only where the BGA maker calls for it
Mask kept clear of the pad
Enlarged, drawn to scale. A 0.8 mm-pitch BGA, with example sizes.
Follow the BGA maker's land pattern where it gives one.
